concepts.def: Polymer of nucleotides forming a double helix; carries genetic information in the bases.
Long DNA molecule packaged with proteins.
Section of DNA coding for the sequence of amino acids in a protein.
Four types: A pairs with T, C pairs with G — complementary base pairing.
The entire genetic material of an organism.
Random change in DNA sequence; can change the protein made (sometimes harmlessly).
